title: explainer
description: Plain-language content layer for one stage. Contains no rendering information.

stage.description: Stage identifier as the project names it, e.g. F1-step3.

brief.description: The user's request, verbatim. Values stated in it count as sourced (source: "brief").

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was done and why it matters.

file.description: Path relative to the output dir, normally data/<name>.

from.description: Original path the file was copied from.

note.description: What to use it for, as the brief said (e.g. 'table scenarios: per-scenario timings').

sources.description: Files named in the brief, copied under the output dir. The gate builds its allowed-value set from these plus the brief.

caption.description: What this step shows, in simple language.

why.description: Why this step was done / why it matters, if not obvious from the caption.

source.description: The `file` of one entry in sources, or "brief".

derived.description: true if the value is computed from source data rather than present in it; the gate then skips the lookup.

data.description: Files the visuals of this step read.
